description: Request a legitimacy check of an online shop or offer before buying: operator identity, legal notice, domain signals, policies, scam indicators, price plausibility. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Hypothesis: EUR 0.50–3 per check.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

context.description: Optional: what you intend to buy and why you are unsure.

expected_price.description: Optional: the price you were offered.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

name: request_merchant_check
title: Request a merchant legitimacy check
